purpose: Bind a resumable, fail-closed handoff that gives the corrected 12-run paper pipeline priority, then executes the prospective state-by-operator factorial, backs up every checkpoint, renders its result into the paper, and reruns release audits.

visibility_at_freeze.note: This operational lock was frozen before the Muon source checkpoint and any crossed-factorial output. It makes no new scientific choice.

main_completion_gate.scheduling_rule: Do not request a factorial GPU lease until this exact main ledger is complete. Cooperative GPU leases alone are insufficient because the main corrected trainer predates them.

source_checkpoint_gate.remote_verification: Before calibration, upload or audit both sealed checkpoints and require complete remote inventories with no missing, extra, size, or digest mismatch.

execution_contract.resume: A completed step is never rerun. A failed step retains every attempt and retries without relaxing its audit. Source or command drift fails closed.
execution_contract.training: Execute all six frozen two-operator waves serially in the implementation protocol order; each wave internally uses the two disjoint four-GPU pools.
execution_contract.checkpoint_backup: Immediately after each wave, upload both complete five-checkpoint run directories to qcz/embedding-optimizer-study-checkpoints under state-operator-factorial-v1/dense and verify path, size, and digest equality.
execution_contract.full_beir: Execute the three declared cell pairs concurrently on disjoint pools, never more than two cell evaluators at once.
execution_contract.publication: Summarize, render the paper-only state-operator include, rebuild the ACL manuscript, refresh the portable evidence closure, and rerun strict paper, test, and style gates.
execution_contract.gpu_boundary: Only the existing factorial calibration, training, probe, and BEIR entry points request cooperative GPU leases. Never inspect, read, edit, signal, stop, replace, or otherwise touch gpu.py or its processes.

claim_boundary: This controller implements the predeclared factorial and publication map. It cannot change source states, continuation operators, calibrated scale, data seeds, branch horizon, estimands, uncertainty, or claim thresholds after outputs appear.
